purpose: Reset the commissioned measurement model around the thesis contribution before the new navigation pilot.
population: Stage-06 admitted observations from the 240 commissioning-fit positions only

spatial_validation.rule: Every camera and heading from one block remains in one fold.

deployed_correction_reason: The two-layer MLP residual correction is the proposed commissioned mean model. Raw, analytic-hull and ridge predictions remain spatially out-of-fold baselines; they do not decide whether the thesis contribution is deployed.

correction_model.target: two-dimensional residual in the camera ray frame
correction_model.epoch_choice: inner spatial validation; deployment uses the median selected epoch

deployed_covariance_reason: Use one transparent conditional covariance family: full covariance per camera and detected-width tertile, shrunk toward the camera covariance, followed by a scalar estimated in nested spatial folds to protect 90/95 percent tail coverage.

covariance_model.residual_source: spatially out-of-fold C3 MLP residuals only
covariance_model.calibration: nested spatial-fold scalar using the larger of the 90 and 95 percent chi-square quantile ratios
reported_diagnostics: fraction beyond the 99 percent chi-square boundary

interpretation: MLP learns the conditional mean error. R is fitted only after that mean is fixed and describes residual scatter conditional on an admitted measurement. Availability is learned separately from all admitted and unavailable opportunities.
